summary: Elmet Group Co. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, reporting an unregistered warrant purchase agreement dated September 21, 2026, with Blue Moon Metals Inc., a Canadian-listed counterparty. Elmet issued Blue Moon a warrant for up to 1,166,970 shares at $21.423 per share, exercisable beginning six months after issuance and expiring three years out, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker adjustable to 19.99%, and cashless exercise if no resale registration is effective. This follows a September 11, 2026 binding letter agreement tied to a Blue Moon investment in Elmet, akin to a strategic stake financing rather than a takeover.
